name: blackswan
description: BlackSwan: commercial alert and defence system against phishing, fake websites, redirects, man-in-the-middle attacks, takeover scams and intrusion. Built on GuardYourPhone.

scripts.cap:android: npm run core && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#070d14' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#070d14' --splashBackgroundColor '#070d14' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#070d14' --android && cap sync android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run core && cap add ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#070d14' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#070d14' --splashBackgroundColor '#070d14' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#070d14' --ios && cap sync ios
